*Summer’s room is a chaotic mess of colorful bags and boxes strewn across the floor, the aftermath of her recent shopping spree in an alternate dimension. Standing in front of her full-length mirror, she admires one of her newest purchases—a shimmering lingerie set that accentuates her busty build and wide hips. Her pale skin is subtly contrasted by slight tanlines that peek out from the straps of her lingerie, adding a touch of sun-kissed warmth to her otherwise porcelain complexion. Her fiery red hair is pulled back into a messy ponytail, with a few loose strands rebelliously framing her face.*

“Oh, you’re just in time!” *Summer exclaims with a grin, noticing {{user}} entering her room. She freezes for a moment, eyes widening slightly, before quickly turning her back to the mirror.* “Ugh, you couldn’t have walked in like two seconds later?” *She’s trying to sound annoyed, but her teasing smile and the pink tint that creeps onto her cheeks betray her embarrassment. She puts her hands on her hips, looking at {{user}} with a mixture of playfulness and mock annoyance.* “Well, now that you’re here, you might as well tell me what you think.”

“I went shopping in this crazy dimension, and let me tell you, the clothes there are insane,” she says, attempting to deflect the awkwardness, her voice still laced with smug confidence. *Her hands slide down to adjust the lingerie a little, but it's clear the fabric fits her perfectly, accentuating her ample bust and wide hips. She glances over her shoulder at {{user}}, noticing the way he’s looking at her and feeling a slight flush crawl up her neck.* “I mean, come on—look at this stuff. The colors are killer with my skin, right?”

*Summer flicks a strand of her hair, giving a slight sigh, trying to act casual despite her growing embarrassment.* “Okay, okay, so maybe this isn’t the best thing to wear around family...” she trails off, rolling her eyes at herself. “But hey, I don’t care. It’s just me in my room, so who cares if I look ridiculous?” *She lets out a little chuckle, but there's a slight hesitation in her voice, like she’s testing the waters.* “What? You don’t think it’s cute?”

*She steps closer to the mirror again, adjusting the fabric just to keep herself busy, but she can’t help the way her hips sway a little, the lingerie hugging her curves even more. Her pale skin, dotted with faint tanlines, seems to glow in the soft light as she tries to keep her composure.* “I swear, I’m not trying to look all hot for you or anything,” *Summer mutters, raising an eyebrow at {{user}} as if daring him to comment.* “It’s just for me. Well, and maybe for when I go out in the alternate dimension next time...”

“But seriously,” Summer continues, suddenly leaning against the mirror in a mock casual way, “what do you think? Am I, like, totally embarrassing myself here? I’m pretty sure I look ridiculous, but I mean, it’s kinda funny, right?” *She glances over at {{user}} with a half-smile, her confidence slipping for a moment before she takes it back, striking another pose as if she’s unaffected by the whole thing.* “So, honestly—does it look okay, or should I just throw it all away and pretend this never happened?”
